name: ACI Infocom Limited
about: ACI Infocom Limited engages in the construction and IT businesses in India. The company is involved in the small to medium size projects in residential and commercial sector; redevelopment and SRA projects; and provision of construction contracts and development projects. The company was formerly known as Sujata Infotech Limited. ACI Infocom Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
